headline: Capital Economics Warns Post-Election Rate Spike Threatens Brazil GDP
summary: Capital Economics warns that surging interest rates following the presidential election pose a greater threat to Brazil's economic growth than currency depreciation does to inflation, potentially deepening the activity slowdown in 2027.
why: Higher borrowing costs and public debt expenses can suppress corporate investment and overall economic expansion.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Rising interest rates restrict credit and weigh on GDP growth.
